verdict.rationale: The Ryzen AI Software stack around this chip has documented APIs, so the axis applies. The docs include copy-paste code examples: a Python `from_pretrained` snippet, ONNX Runtime `InferenceSession` with the Vitis AI EP, and a server interface usable from any language. However, nothing shows an interactive, explorable API reference, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference or explorer, in-browser runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of the docs experience.
